register.labelZh: FLASH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: flash back 可以描述某段回憶突然再次出現在腦海中。；flash by 和 flash past 可以描述日子飛快過去,或人物和交通工具迅速經過。；flash something around/about 可以表示某人四處炫耀金錢、門票、證件或其他物品。；當人們談論回憶、忙碌的日子、旅程或炫耀行為時,這些表達十分有用。
register.summaryEn: Flash back helps you describe a memory that suddenly returns to your mind. Flash by and flash past can describe busy days passing quickly or people and vehicles moving past at high speed. Flash something around/about shows that someone is proudly displaying money, tickets, cards or other possessions. These expressions are useful when people talk about memories, busy periods, journeys and proud behaviour.
